**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **§ 8.2** — Automatic renewals are **12 months** (no multi-year rollover), Customer may opt out on **30 days' written notice**, and Vendor must send a **60-day renewal reminder**, with Customer's opt-out deadline extended 30 days if the reminder is missed. This meets the preferred position, and the extension mechanic is better than our ask.
- **§ 8.3** — Renewal uplifts capped at the **lesser of CPI and 3%**, with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods — exactly our preferred cap.
- **§ 8.1** — Fixed three-year Agreement term with no auto-renewal of the master agreement, so the walk-away triggers (>90-day notice window, auto multi-year renewal) are not present.
- **§ 29.1** — Non-renewal notice is "written" and thus subject to courier/certified mail plus email; workable, so no change requested.
